description: An outdoor seaside terrace photographed at dusk, set at the edge of a swimming pool or infinity pool that mirrors the entire scene in its glass-still surface below. The deck is composed of wide, light-toned teak or hardwood planks running horizontally across the lower portion of the frame. A high-back lounge chair with a densely woven rope-cord weave in warm gray sits to the left of center, its tall wingback silhouette flanked by a matching low rope-and-teak ottoman in front. The chair holds two cushions — a large warm gray seat cushion and a small dark terracotta accent pillow. A warm, diffuse sculptural glow emanates from a freestanding floor-height form positioned to the right of the chair, casting soft white-cream illumination upward and outward onto the surrounding deck, with the warm reflection shimmering in the pool below. Behind the furniture, the horizon opens to a vast flat ocean in deep slate-blue tones, with the faint dark silhouettes of two low islands visible in the distance. The sky above grades from deep blue-purple overhead through warm peachy-orange and salmon at the horizon in a classic post-sunset gradient. The entire scene and sky are reflected precisely in the still pool surface below. The camera is at standing eye-level, roughly 5–6 feet high, with a normal to slightly wide lens. The composition is a wide establishing shot, nearly symmetrical about the horizon line, with the reflection doubling the visual depth. The chair and glow source are placed off-center in the left-center of the frame. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
